modules.title: If your flight is delayed or cancelled
modules.lede: From the Grand Canyon Airlines / Scenic Airlines Contract of Carriage.

rebooking_refund.value: If the carrier cancels or fails to operate a flight, or denies boarding to a passenger with a valid reservation, you can choose either transportation at no extra charge on another of its flights to the same destination (subject to space), or a full refund of the fare paid. If part of the trip has been completed, the refund is the applicable one-way fare for the portion not operated.

oversold.value: On an oversold flight, passengers involuntarily denied boarding are entitled to a full refund of the fare paid.

boarding_pass_cutoff.value: All passengers must obtain a boarding pass from the carrier at least 60 minutes before scheduled departure, or the reservation may be cancelled and payment forfeited.

bag_cutoff.value: Bags must be checked in at the airport at least sixty (60) minutes before scheduled departure; they can be checked up to 4 hours before if you stay at the airport until departure.
